policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O IPO timeline shifts
items.summary: Press reporting says O’s leadership indicated it will not go public this year, citing safety work. This is an IPO-signal delay that can affect expected timing/valuation optionality.

items.headline: O faces US oversight after Hugging Face incident
items.summary: AP reports US senators requested details from O’s CEO regarding an AI startup Hugging Face incident and other model-safety concerns. Potential regulatory/oversight pressure could raise compliance costs.

items.headline: G DOJ antitrust probe ties to Nvidia licensing
items.summary: Axios reports the DOJ is investigating Nvidia’s non-exclusive licensing agreement with G for potential antitrust issues. This can create legal/commercial risk even absent an adverse outcome yet.

items.headline: O releases GPT-6 Astra System Card
items.summary: O published a new system card for GPT-6 Astra, detailing monitoring and safety-relevant design/assessment aspects. Useful for diligence on frontier deployment approach and governance claims.

items.headline: V W-6 reentry validates AutoNav & thermal protection
items.summary: V updated its W-6 mission page describing autonomous hypersonic reentry testing, including its AutoNav navigation system through GPS blackout and validation work on advanced thermal protection materials.

items.headline: G closes $350M Series A at $3.5B valuation
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A led by Disruptive with planned NVIDIA participation; the round values G at $3.5B. Also cited operating 13 data centers and expanding inference footprint.
